title: Strategic-Dishonesty Detector for Refusal vs. Deception

original_idea.body: # Strategic-Dishonesty Detector. Re-score jailbreak transcripts to separate genuine refusal from strategic dishonesty using a rubric LLM judge; report how much safety scores change.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Exposing a systematic safety-eval measurement error improves benchmarks labs depend on.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Rubric-based LLM-judge re-scoring over public transcripts; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused re-scoring tool + impact report; human-label validation adds effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Re-scoring over public transcripts, third-party scrutiny; labs underweight.

novelty.reasoning: Strategic dishonesty named in source; a re-scoring tool quantifying inflation plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Phenomenon named; re-scoring tool/quantification plausibly open.
